While selecting the cloud platform provider, it is critical to compile the 
information gathered and make a detailed and balanced decision, for selecting 
the most suitable platform. Additionally, the following aspects were considered 
to be the most influential while evaluating the services: pricing, range of 
services, leaning curve, integration. 
Azure offers a competitive pricing plan for serverless compute at $0.20 matching 
that of AWS, with GCP falling significantly behind at $0.40. For containerised 
services, AWS comes out on top costing only $28.84 per month, with Azure 
($72) and GCP ($103.72) falling significantly behind. Azure, however, seems to 
be the most cost effective across all database solutions, with the exception of 
object storage with AWS or GCP being the more effective options. Considering 
the developers practical experience, storage and serverless compute costs are 
typically minimal, when compared to containerised services, that require 
constant up time. Highlighting, AWS as the likely most cost effective out of the 
three in real-world terms. 
AWS offers the larges range of services; while Azure and GCP provide similar 
services, AWS’s extensive range of options make it particularly illusive for critical 
areas of this product, such as serverless architectures, and container 
management.
